what: The collector kept 498 GB as Refused at full pressure with 2.4 GB free: 13 of the 14 directories under build/ were cargo target dirs (lanes had set CARGO_TARGET_DIR=~/.cache/blaze/build/<name> on Nov 2-4), with no .blaze-lease and no .blaze-record, and a directory with no lease was refused for ever.
cost: a full disk on the owner's Mac; a session spent on diagnosis
cause: a rule that keeps what it does not recognise, inside a directory that is blaze's own
whys: the disk filled: the collector freed 0 bytes over runs 120-130
every tracked byte was Refused: 'its workspace is refused'
the workspaces had no lease file (fs.rs no_lease)
they were cargo's, not blaze's: lanes pointed cargo at blaze's build/
nothing says who owns a name under a blaze home, so 'unknown' was read as 'not ours, keep' even inside blaze's own root
class: bytes a collector knows and can never free (refusal with no expiry inside an owned root)
prevention: build/ is a registered root: a lease-less directory in it is adopted and collected (fs.rs workspace, cargo_locked); docs/gc.md 'Every byte has an owner'
workaround: the owner removes the 13 directories by hand
fix: written in int-1112, not built or run yet
